old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-iard","title":"RX rule255 address-validation divergence: Python decode_rule255 rejects unspecified/multicast sources, Rust accepts (structure-only per TX/RX split)","description":"Found by review pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-9j6r (P3, pre-existing). The canonical TX/RX split (spec/03-adaptation.md 'Endpoint address policy') says Rule255 DECODING validates structure+checksums only. Rust decode_rule255 follows this strictly: validate_full_ipv6_structure (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:1464) has NO address classification. Python decode_rule255 (python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py:204-215) routes through validate_full_ipv6 which still calls _validate_ipv6_addresses (headers.py:161, post-9j6r reorder) - rejecting unspecified/multicast sources and unspecified dst on RECEIPT. So a UDP packet with valid checksum + multicast source (or unspecified dst) is REJECTED by Python RX but ACCEPTED byte-preserving by Rust RX - same on-air bytes, opposite verdict, exactly the class of divergence k0r2 fixed on the TX side. Also C: the generic rule255 fallback currently does no validation at all (bead 5rvk will add structural validation - its outcome determines C's RX accept set). Fix direction: decide the RX contract for address classes - either (a) Python drops the address checks from validate_full_ipv6 and moves them wholly to the TX wrappers (aligning RX with Rust; note UdpDatagram.from_bytes ALSO rejects unspecified/multicast sources at udp.py:98 - that layer's policy would need the same treatment and its callers audited), or (b) spec is amended to make the unspecified/multicast-source rejection part of the RX structure contract and Rust gains it. Either way pin with shared rule255 vectors whose denial strings distinguish the classes. Coordinate with 5rvk (C fallback validation) so all three land the same contract; the emission-stage function _validate_rule255_emission_endpoints (headers.py:162-181) already holds the TX-only classes.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-08-31T00:02:11.369596912Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-1","updated_at":"2026-08-31T00:02:11.369596912Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-iard","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9j6r","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-08-31T00:02:11.481794737Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-1","metadata":"{}"}]}
